title: Éléments de géométrie algébrique (EGA) — Édition française diplomatique cumulative / Cumulative Diplomatic French Edition
description:
Lire d'abord / Read first: open EGA_French_Cumulative_Reader.pdf. This complete cumulative direct-NUMDAM diplomatic release contains EGA I (including Chapter 0), II, III-1, III-2, and IV-1 through IV-4.

The printed French is preserved diplomatically. Editable TeX, exact source identities, decisions, corrections, inverse controls, deterministic build evidence, visual QA, and SHA-256 manifests are preserved in the language release. Revision r9 rebuilds the cumulative reader from the current R30-bound French source tree and carries the EGA IV-4 standalone reader forward byte-for-byte.
